summary.text: LaTonya Williams is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 10, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an at-large member of the St. Joseph School District Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: LaTonya Williams was elected to an at-large seat on the St. Joseph School District school board in the nonpartisan election of April 6, 2021, and assumed office on April 19, 2021.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Paul Gatewood in the general election.
